sources.title: Intersecting non-SUSY branes and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: The proposed tachyon transition is tested by matching charge, transverse horizon/bubble size and asymptotic circle length in controlled limits. Chargeless F-strings are inferred by matching a neutral specialization of the intersecting solutions to another F-string/Dp-brane family.

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric D1/D5, F/NS5 and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: Start from a non-supersymmetric type IIA D0/D4 intersection, solve for a transverse delocalization creating an isometry, and T-dualize to D1/D5. Unlike BPS arrays, this delocalization cannot rely on a no-force construction.

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Scan λ and four scalar variables in the stated bounded box, retain positive selected pieces with residuals below 0.05, and inspect the smallest logarithmic-Hessian eigenvalue. Tightening the residual is a convergence diagnostic rather than proof of exhaustive critical-point coverage.

sources.title: Don't panic! Closed string tachyons in ALE space-times

evidence.text: In the low-curvature regime, choose RG coordinates giving metric Ricci flow and dilaton diffusion. For time evolution, use the Einstein-frame description as a massless scalar coupled to gravity; large-n, n→n−2 transitions permit linearized diffusion and wave analyses.

sources.title: Closed string tachyons and semiclassical instabilities

evidence.text: Euclidean Kerr bounce solutions, decay estimates Γ ∼ exp(−I), and analytic continuation from a zero-momentum surface to study Lorentzian bubble expansion.

sources.title: On Witten's Instability and Winding Tachyons

evidence.text: Couple a scalar with radial-dependent winding mass to gravity. Expand near the bubble wall in locally Cartesian coordinates and reduce the S-wave quadratic fluctuation problem to a shifted two-dimensional harmonic oscillator.

sources.title: Mirror symmetry and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: What do protected N=2 worldsheet RG flows and mirror symmetry imply about closed-string tachyon condensation in compact and noncompact backgrounds, and what probe-theory dualities might follow?

sources.title: APS instability and the topology of the brane-world

evidence.text: Can string-theoretic stability constrain the spatial topology of an accelerating universe, by testing supersymmetry of the AdS5 orbifold required to contain its de Sitter brane?

sources.title: T-duality for non-critical heterotic strings

evidence.text: Determine the global deformation spaces and T-duality groups of full-rank non-critical heterotic strings on a circle, and interpret their symmetry enhancements and dimension-changing tachyon condensation in terms of heterotic branes.

sources.title: Aspects of strings without spacetime supersymmetry

evidence.text: How do tachyons and scalar tadpoles obstruct stable string vacua without spacetime supersymmetry, and what can worldsheet diagnostics, off-shell formulations and gravitational background shifts establish?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking Warped Throats and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can orientifold sectors that break supersymmetry explicitly generate stable throats while their leading large-N geometry appears supersymmetric?

sources.title: Integrability treatment of AdS/CFT orbifolds

evidence.text: How can Abelian AdS/CFT orbifolds be implemented consistently across string boundary conditions, spin chains, TBA and the quantum spectral curve, and can this framework eventually resolve type 0B tachyon stability at intermediate coupling?

sources.title: Nonperturbative Instability of AdS(5) x S**5/Z(k)

evidence.text: Does the freely acting, nonsupersymmetric AdS₅×S⁵/Z_k orbifold remain nonperturbatively unstable when large coupling removes its closed-string tachyons, and what does the decay imply for its strongly coupled gauge-theory interpretation?

sources.title: Tachyon condensation on the brane anti-brane system

evidence.text: Does the negative tachyon potential energy at its classical minimum exactly cancel the tensions of a coincident D-brane–anti-D-brane pair, giving zero energy density and restoring spacetime supersymmetry? The paper supplies an argument for an earlier conjecture.

sources.title: Quantum Breaking Bound on de Sitter and Swampland

evidence.text: Compare local tachyonic growth with Hubble-scale diffusion, then test whether any resulting patch can outlive the quantum deadline. The paper uses this asymptotic comparison rather than solving a stochastic first-passage problem.

sources.title: On the weak gravity conjecture in string theory with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: Interpret the finite r=0 D1 self-energy as a tension correction. Parameterize higher-loop long-distance exchange using effective tension, effective charge and a dilaton mass; estimate the crossover maximum using the lower real branch of the Lambert W function.

sources.title: Weak gravity (and other conjectures) with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: Compute the magnetically twisted annulus and transform it to a four-factor theta representation. Spectral stability, long-range force signs, and small-distance behavior must be checked against this common starting amplitude.

sources.title: Dynamical tadpoles and Weak Gravity Constraints

evidence.text: Subtract the mean source, solve the remaining modes, and impose zero mean. The paper uses this mathematically consistent replacement to diagnose a physical modification of the background equations.

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking, brane dynamics and Swampland conjectures

evidence.text: The D1 world-volume analysis uses one-loop functional determinants around separated-stack scalar configurations and a heat-kernel argument for gauge-coupling running.

sources.title: Smeared end-of-the-world branes

evidence.text: Numerically shoot from the ETW boundary using the scalar equation, a null-contracted Einstein equation and the radial constraint. Diagnose fragmentation with the effective potential of a single constituent brane displaced radially, including tension and Wess–Zumino couplings.

sources.title: Tachyon dynamics in open string theory

evidence.text: How does open-string tachyon condensation resolve unstable D-branes: what replaces the unstable vacuum, how do lower-dimensional branes emerge, and what does rolling tachyon dynamics imply about closed-string decay and open-string completeness?

evidence.text: Can perturbative orientifolds realize brane supersymmetry breaking without NS-NS disk tadpoles or open-string instabilities, while separating open-sector breaking from gravitino masses and testing the proposed obstruction to massless gravitinos?

evidence.text: Under what compactification and brane configurations can macroscopic F-, D-, and wrapped-brane strings survive breakage, tachyon decay, and axion-domain-wall confinement long enough to become observable cosmic strings?

evidence.text: Real continuous envelopes are constructed by freezing phase values on integer residue classes. A finite phase-sum lemma gives zero when α>1 and the step m is not divisible by α. Closed-string products use envelopes indexed modulo lcm(α,β).

evidence.text: Open-string power laws are inferred from η-function S-transformation asymptotics. evidence.text: Summing Kloosterman residues selects only Rademacher index ℓ=1 for K and A, and ℓ=2 for M. These terms recover the S and P transformations connecting dual channels; explicit model calculations also use Chan–Paton coefficients and tadpole constraints.

evidence.text: Adapt previously developed odd-spin-structure one-loop amplitude methods to Klein bottle, annulus and Möbius strip contributions. Canonical anomalous amplitudes contain N gauge and M gravitational insertions with N+M=D/2+1 and one longitudinal polarization.

sources.title: Open strings

evidence.text: Boundary-CFT constructions use Cardy-type annulus coefficients and fusion rules. A complementary rational-model algorithm uses the Möbius amplitude to linearize constraints on Chan–Paton multiplicities, solving signed-integer Diophantine conditions with annulus/Möbius agreement modulo two.

sources.title: Some properties of open string theories

evidence.text: Use S to transform Klein-bottle and annulus channels, and P=T^{1/2}ST²ST^{1/2} for the Möbius strip. Express vacuum amplitudes using double-cover moduli so their relative normalizations can be compared when imposing tadpole cancellation.

sources.title: Consistency conditions for orientifolds and D-manifolds

evidence.text: Evaluate Klein-bottle, Möbius-strip and cylinder vacuum traces; apply modular transformations and Poisson resummation to extract long-cylinder massless exchange. Solve the resulting algebraic and tadpole conditions and project the massless Chan–Paton wavefunctions.

sources.title: Consistency conditions for branes at orbifold singularities

evidence.text: Use Chan–Paton orbifold/orientifold representations and affine SU(M) Cartan relations. Extract irreducible anomaly terms from tadpole expressions linear in ranks and reducible terms from rank bilinears; infer tensor–gauge couplings.

evidence.text: Which string-defect consistency conditions constrain six-dimensional supergravity beyond anomaly cancellation, and how do explicit orientifolds delimit their applicability to BPS defects, stable non-BPS defects and localized supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Aspects of Stability, Rigidity and Unitarity in String Vacua

evidence.text: How do high-mass spectral cancellations diagnose tree-level tachyons, how do tadpole constraints produce rigid six-dimensional orientifolds, and what additional consistency conditions follow from defect unitarity and Dai–Freed anomalies?

sources.title: Rigid vacua with Brane Supersymmetry Breaking

evidence.text: Can local, nontrivial cancellation of twisted R-R charges produce BSB orientifolds with fewer brane deformation moduli, and how should their gauge kinetic functions and string-defect unitarity constraints be formulated?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization with open and closed string fluxes

evidence.text: Can constant magnetic fluxes on wrapped D9 branes, combined with closed-string three-form fluxes, stabilize all closed-string moduli in supersymmetric T^6/Z2 orientifolds while satisfying tadpole and world-volume consistency conditions?

sources.title: Anomaly cancellations in type I D-9 - anti-D-9 system and the USp(32) string theory

evidence.text: Which massless spectra, anomaly cancellations and R-R tadpole conditions make ten-dimensional D9–anti-D9 systems consistent, and does a symplectic orientifold projection yield a tachyon-free nonsupersymmetric USp(32) endpoint?
